extractions.value: The patient developed GAD65 autoimmunity after nivolumab treatment for metastatic melanoma. The presentation included epilepsy, limbic encephalitis, cerebellar ataxia, and stiff person syndrome, covering the full spectrum of GAD65-associated conditions. The patient died 13 months after neurological symptom onset due to cancer progression.
extractions.quote: This case expands the spectrum of GAD65-associated conditions induced by immune-checkpoint inhibitor and underlines treatment complexity when both neurological complications and tumour recurrence occur.
